en.Essa rã congela inteira no inverno... e: This frog freezes solid every winter... and comes back to life! And the last fact is the worst.
en.É a rã-da-madeira, dos Estados Unidos e: It's the wood frog, from the US and Canada. Follow Maia, it gets worse: in the cold, more than half of its body turns to ice.
en.O coração para de bater, e ela para de r: Its heart stops beating, and it stops breathing.
en.No Alasca, ela fica assim por até sete m: In Alaska, it stays like that for up to seven months, at minus eighteen degrees Celsius.
